name: New York
short: In New York your heat pump rebate depends on your electric utility. NYS Clean Heat pays $4,000 to $7,000 for a full system in a standard home, and up to $11,000 through Con Edison, $12,000 through Central Hudson, $13,000 through NYSEG and RG&E, and $14,000 through National Grid and Orange & Rockland for a weatherized home that removes its old heating system in a disadvantaged community. PSEG Long Island runs its own program at $4,000 to $7,500. Income-eligible homes can get free upgrades through EmPower+. The federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.
